name: gradient-scale-cut-text
title: Gradient Scale Cut Text
description: An oversized gradient reveal snaps to a compact blurred line that settles into focus.
useWhen: A title should begin at an imposing scale and resolve through a deliberately abrupt editorial cut.
A gradient reveal needs to continue across two very different framings.
avoidWhen: The scale change must feel continuous: use scale-down-fade or zoom-words.
The text should stay one size while a gradient passes over it: use shimmer-sweep.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Title that is revealed at giant scale, then cut to compact.

variables.label: Giant font size
variables.description: Type size of the first, oversized framing, in px at a 1920 px wide frame.

variables.label: Compact font size
variables.description: Type size after the cut, in px at a 1920 px wide frame.

variables.label: Gradient start
variables.description: Color at the leading edge of the gradient.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Color of the field behind the text.

variables.label: Anchor offset
variables.description: Horizontal offset of the text from the center.

variables.label: Giant travel
variables.description: How far the giant framing drifts left before the cut.

variables.label: Settle travel
variables.description: How far right of its place the compact line starts.

variables.label: Cut frame
variables.description: Frame of the cut from giant to compact (30 fps).

variables.label: Reveal softness
variables.description: Softness of the reveal edge, in percent of the line.

variables.label: Compact blur
variables.description: Blur in pixels the compact line starts with.
